assets.title: Socketed Tuft Bee Brush
assets.description: One original static long-backed bee brush, counted as one prop. One continuous thick honey-brown wooden-looking silhouette joins a broad elongated brush back to a narrowed handle and a true polygonal hanging hole. Three distinct rows of eight cream-coloured closed tuft bundles rise from 24 actual blind seats in the long face. Every tuft has a finite flat root supported on the full seat floor; finite annular root clearance remains inside every pocket. Gently flared, slightly swept and bevel-crowned bundles remain separated by complete real row and column air corridors. The broad continuous back rests flat at ground with bristles pointing upward. Twenty-five closed editable mesh components and three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. No reused paintbrush, end ferrule, loose bristles, particles, textures, bees, hive, person, stand or scene. Static illustrative geometry only: no sweeping or cleaning performance, softness, hair physics, animal or human use or safety, bee behavior, material suitability, manufacturing, durability, loading, ergonomics, certification or old hive/frame compatibility claim.
